description: Type-safe raw SQL for Python: row and parameter types inferred from your SQL and schema, no ORM or database needed
rules: Start each query string with --sql and a newline, for example "--sql\nSELECT id::INTEGER FROM users".
Run sqlty rewrite to wrap queries in SQL[T], then sqlty check to validate them.
Point schema in [tool.sqlty] of pyproject.toml at a schema.sql file to infer column types without casts.
SQL[T] is a str subclass, so a wrapped query works anywhere a string does.
sqlty strip also removes hand-written row types such as SQL[User]; prefer editing the SQL in place and running sqlty check.
